Name: MissCoriel's Supplement Pack - Nocturnal Ambience
Author: MissCoriel
Description:
Crickets too boring?  Nocturnal Ambience will change that for you.  5 songs from an old game I (still) play, remade and redone by me to better accent the quiet nights of Stardew Valley.  Some songs will only play on certain seasons... but each season has 2 common themes, except fall.

[b]1.0.1 Notes:
[/b][i]I fixed firenight so it isn't too quiet.. but I also remade it to a newer version.  The Playlist below has the new version now.[/i]

[soundcloud]https://soundcloud.com/evilpickle-music-dept/sets/nocturnal-ease[/soundcloud]
Here is the tracks within the mod.

Installation is easy:
Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043]Custom Music[/url] and everything it needs
Place this mod in your Mods folder.
